title: Emergency fund
breadWhy: The everyday staple you always keep on hand.
summary: Build a cushion for urgent costs you couldn't plan for, so a surprise stays a bad day instead of a bad year.

tips.title: Why small deposits add up
tips.body: You don't need a big amount to make progress. A small deposit every week adds up faster than you'd expect, and each one makes the next surprise a little less stressful. Steady beats big.

tips.title: Make it automatic
tips.body: Saving works best when you don't have to remember it. Ask your bank to move a set amount into savings on payday or every week. Then your fund grows even on busy weeks.

tips.title: When it's the right time to use it
tips.body: Ask yourself: is this urgent, and could I have planned for it? If it's urgent and unplanned, like a repair you need to get to work, this fund is for exactly that. Using it is not a setback. You can rebuild.

tips.title: Choosing your next loaf
tips.body: Your cushion is built, so you're ready for what's next. Your next loaf can be paying down high-interest debt or starting to invest. We'll suggest one based on what you told us, and you pick.
